name: Engineering contract control action-task bridge
type: AM Platform / Engineering contracts / task-control bridge
requiresDatabases: Existing project-local task store or adapter

dataIsolation.guard: The bridge accepts tenant-scoped, project-local evidence and returns an instruction only; it never writes customer tasks, Notion, LINE, or production data.

definitionOfDone: Action-task intent uses deterministic semantic and state keys
Formal intent requires project goal and project-local source evidence
Missing requirements become candidate pending confirmation
Every create/update intent records status-change evidence
The bridge has no direct external side effects
